candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get ear problem and dem don see pus dey come out from e ear for 14 days. Ear discharge dey, but e no get ear pain. E no get tender swelling for back of ear. E no dey convulse now and dem never see convulsion before. E no dey lethargic or unconscious. E still fit chop or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. E no get cough or difficult to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get fever.
